about.metaDescription: StudentX helps students find housing near their university in Thessaloniki, Greece. Free for students, free for landlords.
about.title: About StudentX
about.intro: StudentX is a student housing directory built for Thessaloniki. By students, for students.
about.missionBody: We bridge the gap between students and landlords. With a purpose-built platform that puts proximity to campus at the center of every search.
about.step1Body: Pick your faculty, set your budget and preferences, and see listings ranked by distance to your classes.
about.step2Body: Send an inquiry directly through the platform. No middlemen, no fees for students.
about.step3Body: Find your place, sign your lease, and focus on what matters — your studies.
about.contactBody: Have a question or want to partner with us? Reach out to us!

meta.title: Medical School Admissions
meta.description: One-to-one medical school admissions coaching — application strategy, personal statement, UCAT and interview preparation, backed by a money-back guarantee.

hero.headline: We get you into your medical school of choice or you keep your money.
hero.subhead: One-to-one coaching through every stage of your application — strategy, personal statement, UCAT and interviews. We only take students we believe we can get in.

guarantee.heading: The guarantee
guarantee.promise: We get you into your medical school of choice or you keep your money.
guarantee.detail: We only work with students we think we can place, and we tell you honestly at the diagnostic call if that isn't you. If you complete the programme, meet every deadline we set, and still receive no offer, you pay nothing.

who.heading: Who this is for
who.item1: Applicants to UK and European medical schools, applying this cycle or next.
who.item2: Students who will do the work — this is coaching, not a service that applies for you.
who.item3: Anyone who wants an honest read on their chances before spending a year on it.
who.notFor1: Anyone looking to have a personal statement written for them. We coach; you write.
who.notFor2: Applicants who come to us after the cycle's deadlines have already passed.

steps.heading: How it works
steps.subhead: Four stages, from an honest diagnostic to the offer.
steps.s1Body: Free, no obligation. We look at your grades, your predicted results and your target schools, and tell you plainly whether we can help.
steps.s2Body: Which schools, in which order, and why. School choice is the single biggest lever most applicants get wrong.
steps.s3Body: Structured drafting and review of your statement, plus a timed UCAT preparation plan built around your weakest sections.
steps.s4Body: Mock MMI and panel interviews with feedback, run to the format of the schools that invite you.

proof.heading: What you get
proof.stat1Label: Every session is one-to-one. No group webinars, no recorded courses.
proof.stat2Label: Stages of support, from school choice through to your final interview.
proof.stat3Label: Cost if you complete the programme and receive no offer.
proof.disclaimer: StudentX is an independent coaching service. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or acting on behalf of any university or admissions body.

faq.heading: Questions
faq.q1: What counts as "my medical school of choice"?
faq.a1: It's agreed in writing with you at the start of the programme, based on what your grades realistically support. The full definition is in the guarantee terms.
faq.q2: What do I have to do to keep the guarantee?
faq.a2: Complete the programme, hit every deadline we set, and submit the applications we agree on. The terms set this out in full.
faq.a3: Fees depend on how much of the cycle you have left and how many schools you're targeting. We quote you after the free diagnostic call, before you commit to anything.
faq.q4: Do you write my personal statement?
faq.a4: No. Admissions tutors can tell, and most schools now screen for it. We coach you through structure, content and redrafting — the writing is yours.
faq.a5: UK and European medical schools. Tell us your target list on the diagnostic call and we'll say honestly whether we know those schools well enough to help.
faq.q6: What happens on the diagnostic call?
faq.a6: Thirty minutes, free. We look at where you actually stand and give you a straight answer about your chances — including if that answer is that you don't need us.

cta.heading: Start with an honest conversation
cta.body: The diagnostic call is free and there's no obligation. If we don't think we can get you in, we'll tell you on the call.

terms.title: Guarantee terms
terms.placeholder: The full terms of the admissions guarantee — eligibility, the definition of an agreed target school, programme requirements, and the refund process — are being finalised and will be published here before the programme opens to applicants. Until then, everything that would appear here is covered explicitly in writing before you pay anything.
